_eligibility_text:
1. The shaheed should belong to a Scheduled Tribe or Scheduled Caste. 
1. The family should be residing in one of the selected Shaheed villages.
1. The shaheed family should live in a kutcha house and not have availed of benefits from any housing scheme in the last 5 years.
1. Priority will be given to descendants of freedom fighters from selected villages.
